content: See attached my summoning bank - what pouches should I make to level the most economically?

Hail **RozRaid**! I’ve analyzed your attached bank image alongside your live profile stats (currently **Level 80 Summoning** with 2,017,882 XP). 

You are sitting on a massive goldmine of charms and secondaries! By making the most economic pouch choices—specifically capitalizing on your **5,668 Swamp Toads** already in your bank—you can gain **~1.49 Million XP** without spending excessive GP, boosting you straight from **Level 80 to Level 85 Summoning**!

---

### 📦 Bank Inventory Audit

From your screenshot, here is your breakdown of unusable vs. usable Summoning supplies:

| Item / Charm | Quantity in Bank | Recommended Pouch Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Crimson Charms** | **3,175** | Granite Lobster (Lvl 74) |
| **Gold Charms** | **2,581** | Barking Toad (Lvl 66) |
| **Green Charms** | **790** | Fruit Bat (Lvl 69) |
| **Blue Charms** | **48** | Geyser Titan (Lvl 80) |
| **Swamp Toads** | **5,668** | **Secondary Material** *(Already Owned!)* |
| **Spirit Shards** | **36,534** | Active Shard Stock |

---

### ⚔️ Most Economical Pouch Strategy

To maximize GP efficiency, we prioritize using your **Crimson Charms** first (best XP/charm ratio) and utilizing the **5,668 Swamp Toads** sitting in your bank to make **Gold Charms** 100% free on secondaries.

#### 1. Crimson Charms: [Granite Lobster](https://runescape.wiki/w/Granite_lobster_pouch) (Level 74)
* **XP per Pouch**: 374.4 XP
* **Requirements**: 1 Crimson Charm, 166 Spirit Shards, 1 Granite (500g)
* **Why it's economical**: Granite (500g) is extremely cheap on the Grand Exchange. Granite Lobsters offer the single best Crimson XP-to-cost ratio at your level until Level 85.
* **XP Yield**: 3,175 Charms × 374.4 XP = **1,188,720 XP**

#### 2. Gold Charms: [Barking Toad](https://runescape.wiki/w/Barking_toad_pouch) (Level 66)
* **XP per Pouch**: 87.0 XP
* **Requirements**: 1 Gold Charm, 225 Spirit Shards, 1 Swamp Toad
* **Why it's economical**: You already own **5,668 Swamp Toads** in your bank! This makes secondary costs **0 GP**.
* **XP Yield**: 2,581 Charms × 87.0 XP = **224,547 XP**

#### 3. Green Charms: [Fruit Bat](https://runescape.wiki/w/Fruit_bat_pouch) (Level 69)
* **XP per Pouch**: 84.0 XP
* **Requirements**: 1 Green Charm, 130 Spirit Shards, 1 Banana
* **Why it's economical**: Bananas are practically free on the GE. Green charms have lower XP overall, but this clears them out cheaply.
* **XP Yield**: 790 Charms × 84.0 XP = **66,360 XP**

#### 4. Blue Charms: [Geyser Titan](https://runescape.wiki/w/Geyser_titan_pouch) (Level 80)
* **XP per Pouch**: 222.4 XP
* **Requirements**: 1 Blue Charm, 222 Spirit Shards, 1 Water Talisman
* **Why it's economical**: You only have 48 Blue Charms, so burn them quickly on the highest level titan you can make.
* **XP Yield**: 48 Charms × 222.4 XP = **10,675 XP**

---

### 📈 Expected Level Progression

| Stage | Charms Used | Total XP Gained | Resulting Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Current Stats** | — | **2,017,882 XP** | **Level 80** |
| + Gold Charms | 2,581 Barking Toads | +224,547 XP | Level 81 |
| + Green Charms | 790 Fruit Bats | +66,360 XP | Level 81 |
| + Blue Charms | 48 Geyser Titans | +10,675 XP | Level 81 |
| + Crimson Charms | 3,175 Granite Lobsters | +1,188,720 XP | **Level 85** |
| **FINAL TOTAL** | **6,594 Charms** | **~3,508,184 XP** | **Level 85 Summoning** 🚀 |

---

### 💡 Pro-Tips for Maximum Efficiency & GP Savings

1. **Trade Pouches Back to Pikkupstix**:
   * Train at the **Taverley Obelisk**. You can sell your crafted pouches directly to **Pikkupstix** or the shopkeeper next to the obelisk and buy them back as noted items, or sell them to recoup **70% of your Spirit Shard costs**!
2. **Save Swamp Toads for Level 85**:
   * If you prefer, you can save your remaining **Swamp Toads** until you hit **Level 85 Summoning** to make [Swamp Titans](https://runescape.wiki/w/Swamp_titan_pouch) (373.6 XP each using **Crimson Charms** + 1 Swamp Toad)!
3. **Synergy with your Goals**:
   * Hitting **Level 85 Summoning** fulfills a major milestone toward unlocking high-tier combat familiars to assist with your target boss, **Kree'arra**, as well as working toward your **Prifddinas** entry requirements.

For complete training formulas and shard costs, check out the official [Pay-to-play Summoning training guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Summoning_training_guide).
